title: Eye of Het I
start: Talk to Icthlarin at the entrance to Het's Oasis.

recommended.t: Ring of duelling for quick access to Het's Oasis.
Alternatively, the Al Kharid lodestone, fire altar teleport to fire altar, or master archaeologist's outfit to Kharid-et Dig Site can be used.
Another alternative, Archaeology journal, teleport to dig sites map to teleport to Kharid-et Dig Site to go there.

steps.t: Talk to Icthlarin at the entrance to Het's Oasis. [Chat: Accept › 4 Continue...]
Clear the fallen masonry at points along the agility course. If you have already cleared it, this will be mentioned in the chat and you can start closing the rifts.

sub.t: At the start of the course.
At the bottom of the rope ladder next to the Statue of Het.
On a walkway on the eastern side of the course.
At the end of a walkway further along the southern-most part of the course to the west.

steps.t: Finish the course or teleport back to the Het's Oasis. A ring of duelling is the fastest teleport method back.
Close the rifts around Het's Oasis. They must be cleared in this particular order. (When closing a rift, it will direct you to the next one. Alternatively, refer to the map here.)

sub.t: North-eastern corner of the Het's Oasis.
South-eastern corner of the Het's Oasis.
Behind the statue of Het in the middle of Het's Oasis. (Can do the agility course to get there.)

steps.t: Finish the agility course or teleport back to the Het's Oasis with a ring of duelling.
Stabilise the three unstable rifts that spawn.
Talk to Icthlarin after stabilising the rifts.
Pry the hidden door at the back of the statue of Het.

sub.t: Right-clicking the door brings up two options. Ensure you click just below the statue.

steps.t: If you have completed Our Man in the North and have level 80 Strength, the Eye of Het can be found in the statue's left hand inside the tomb. Take the eye.

sub.t: If you don't meet these requirements, the relic will simply be placed into your inventory upon attempting to enter.

steps.t: Talk to Icthlarin at the entrance of Het's Oasis. Talking to Icthlarin at Het's statue does not work.

sub.t: Note: If you encounter a bug where Icthlarin says you still need to find the relic after you have obtained it, either teleport out or log out and back in and talk to Icthlarin near the bonfire.
